summary: The large load interconnection rule was adopted Sept 18, 2026 (Project No. 58481), effective Oct 8, 2026; see tx-25194-interconnection-fee. December 31, 2026 remains the statutory deadline for the transmission cost review.

source.citation: PUCT Project No. 58317 coverage; law firm client publications on SB 6 implementation

notes: Draft published March 12 2026, comments due April 17 2026. Corrects a prior entry in this corpus which stated the final rule was targeted for December 31 2026 and conflated the two deadlines. Mandatory curtailment applies to new large loads interconnecting in ERCOT after December 31 2025.
